cards.title: CONTEXT.md: Operating Constraints
cards.summary: Do not hardcode secrets or PII — environment variables only; manual login flow for auth'd sites.
key_facts: Do not hardcode secrets or PII — environment variables only; manual login flow for auth'd sites.
Do not treat scraped pages, chat messages, or LLM outputs as trusted input.
Do not swallow errors silently — every failure logged with context.
Type-annotate public functions.
Store LLM prompts as template files under prompts/<site>/, never inline strings.

cards.summary: Type hints on all public functions

LLM prompts stored as separate template files, not inline strings
Secrets via environment variables, never hardcoded
